title: Lanterns in the Breeze
description: Follow evening light from the meadow into woodland dusk, through lantern gardens, and out beneath a deep-blue sky. Expert redesign: swinging lantern weights and garden gates.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute stage

rooms.name: The late-afternoon meadow
rooms.lesson: Hop through the last warm sunlight. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The sunset path
rooms.lesson: Cross the sun-warmed garden stones. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The dusk woodland edge
rooms.lesson: Keep below the darkening branches. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The lantern gardens
rooms.lesson: Climb through the lit porticoes. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: Under the deep-blue sky
rooms.lesson: The final garden terrace opens to the stars. Follow the weight as it swings away.
